d: Al Emadi Enterprises is a diversified powerhouse and an integrated ecosystem serving Qatar. Built on vision and driven by a legacy of excellence, the group has established itself as a name synonymous with trust.

We operate across multiple sectors, creating value and driving innovation. As we enter our next chapter of rapid growth and strategic transformation, we are strengthening our shared services and operating model to support a growing portfolio that includes Al Emadi Properties, Top Performance, Exclusive Motors, Al Emadi Stones, Alhazm Mall, Alhazm Hospitality, Alhazm Events, and Darzi Retail.
We are seeking an experienced and ambitious Marketing Manager to elevate our brand presence and drive our marketing strategy across the full group portfolio.

The Marketing Manager will serve as a strategic leader responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing and e-commerce initiatives across the full Al Emadi Enterprises portfolio, including real estate, automotive, natural marble and stone, luxury retail, hospitality, food and beverage, world-class events, destination marketing, and digital commerce businesses.
This role requires a business-oriented professional capable of aligning marketing efforts with growth objectives.

The successful candidate will manage cross-channel marketing campaigns, enhance brand digital presence, initiate and accelerate e-commerce growth, and ensure consistent customer experience across all business units. By leveraging market insights and performance data, the Marketing Manager will drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention strategies that support the overarching goals of the CEO and the broader enterprise.
q: Candidates must possess a strong foundation in business and marketing strategy.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field is required, with a master's degree or MBA considered highly advantageous.

Candidates should demonstrate significant experience in a senior marketing role, preferably within a diversified holding company or across multiple fast-paced industries such as real estate, automotive, or luxury retail.

A proven track record of developing and executing successful, data-driven marketing, social-media, and e-commerce campaigns is essential. Experience growing online sales, improving e-commerce's conversion, building social-media communities, managing paid-social performance, and leading content or influencer partnerships is highly preferred.
Candidates must exhibit strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex market data and translate it into strategic action.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are required to effectively manage stakeholder relationships and present marketing strategies to the CEO .
Furthermore, candidates must possess a deep understanding of the Qatar market dynamics and cultural nuances, alongside fluency in English and Arabic.
r: Strategic Marketing Leadership: The Marketing Manager is tasked with designing and implementing an overarching marketing strategy that aligns with the strategic transformation goals of Al Emadi Enterprises. This involves translating business objectives into actionable marketing plans across diverse sectors, including real estate, automotive, natural stone and marble, premium retail, luxury destination marketing, hospitality, food and bverage, and flagship events. The leader will oversee market research to identify emerging trends, analyze competitor positioning, and uncover new market opportunities in Qatar and the broader region.

Brand Management, Corporate Communications, PR, and Strategic Events: A critical component of this role is safeguarding and elevating the Al Emadi Enterprises brand. The Marketing Manager will ensure that all external communications reflect the company's legacy of trust and its vision for the future. This includes managing corporate communications, public relations, media partnerships, proactive media engagement, and reputation management. The role requires developing compelling narratives that highlight the group's integrated ecosystem and the unique value proposition of its individual entities, including Al Emadi Properties, Top Performance, Exclusive Motors, Alhazm Mall, Alhazm Hospitality, Alhazm Events, Al Emadi Stones, and Darzi Retail.

The Marketing Manager will also direct the marketing and communications workstream for high-stakes public-relations, product launches, major brand announcements, national events, and flagship group events. Working closely with Alhazm Events and relevant business leaders, the successful candidate will establish clear communication processes to ensure consistent, timely, and high-quality brand representation before, during, and after every critical engagement.

Campaign Execution and Digital Optimization: The successful candidate will lead the end-to-end execution of integrated marketing and e-commerce campaigns. This encompasses managing digital marketing channels, traditional advertising, online storefronts, e-commerce conversion initiatives, and digital customer journeys. The Marketing Manager will establish a robust performance tracking framework, utilizing key performance indicators to measure campaign effectiveness, online sales performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, marketing spend, and return on investment. Furthermore, the role involves close collaboration with the sales, operations, and technology teams to ensure that marketing and e-commerce initiatives directly support revenue generation and customer satisfaction.

Social Media and Content Leadership: The Marketing Manager will own the group-wide social-media strategy and ensure that each business unit has a clear channel plan, content calendar, visual direction, and publishing cadence. The role will guide the creation of high-quality, brand-aligned content across organic and paid platforms, including campaign assets, short-form video, editorial content, customer stories, and event coverage. The successful candidate will set standards for community management, response quality, escalation, and reputation management, ensuring that audiences receive a timely and consistent experience across the group’s social channels. The Marketing Manager will also identify, assess, and manage influencer, creator, media, and content-production partnerships that contribute to reach, engagement, brand relevance, and commercial outcomes.

The role will oversee paid-social planning and optimization, coordinating targeting, creative testing, lead generation, retargeting, and conversion activity with the broader media and e-commerce strategy. The Marketing Manager will use these insights to continuously improve content, media investment, and channel effectiveness across all group companies.

Team Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration: Operating within a shared services framework, the Marketing Manager will build and mentor a high-performing marketing team. This involves fostering a culture of creativity, accountability, and continuous improvement. The leader will collaborate closely with division heads, the executive leadership team, and external agency partners to ensure seamless execution of marketing activities across the full group portfolio, including and not limited to: Al Emadi Properties, Top Performance, Exclusive Motors, Al Emadi Stones, Alhazm Mall, Alhazm Hospitality, Alhazm Events, and Darzi Retail.
